entities.name: L2 U2N Relay UE
entities.description: The UE acting as a relay in Layer 2 UE-to-Network relay architecture responsible for managing connections to remote UEs.

entities.name: sl-RemoteUE-ToReleaseList
entities.description: A list containing sl-L2Identity-Remote values identifying remote UEs that should be released.

entities.name: sl-L2Identity-Remote
entities.description: Layer 2 identifier used to uniquely identify a remote UE in the PC5 RRC connection context.

entities.name: PC5 RRC connection
entities.description: The RRC connection established over PC5 interface between relay UE and remote UE.

entities.name: PC5-RRC connection release
entities.description: Procedure to release an existing PC5 RRC connection as specified in clause 5.8.9.5.

entities.name: Release triggered by sl-RemoteUE-ToReleaseList
entities.description: Condition where the release procedure is initiated upon reception of sl-RemoteUE-ToReleaseList.

entities.name: Active PC5 RRC connection exists
entities.description: Condition where the current UE has an active PC5 RRC connection to a L2 U2N Remote UE with matching sl-L2Identity-Remote.

relations.description: The L2 U2N Relay UE behavior is triggered by reception of sl-RemoteUE-ToReleaseList.
The release procedure checks if an active PC5 RRC connection exists for each sl-L2Identity-Remote.
If an active PC5 RRC connection exists, the relay UE performs PC5-RRC connection release.
PC5-RRC connection release procedure terminates the existing PC5 RRC connection.
